_meta.description: Hand-curated X (Twitter) posts, newest first. Each post is printed as a ruled row (date, author, text); X's script loads only when a reader asks for one full post with its photos. 'status' grades the post's claims, not the account: posts by enthusiasts are 'reported' at best; posts by MMRDA and by the line's operator, Maha Mumbai Metro (MMMOCL), are 'verified'. Dates come from the post ID.

posts.author: Hrishi
posts.text: A new I-girder is in place at Juhu Circle. He expects this section to be finished in one to one and a half months, and trial runs possible in six to seven months. Two videos.

posts.author: Swarup Bodke
posts.text: The Shunya bridge over the Vakola nallah in BKC: girders are launched on the Mandale side, but there is no progress over the nallah yet, and the cables are still to be put in. Two photos.

posts.author: Swarup Bodke
posts.text: The curved cantilever bridge over the Mithi river will join soon: only 5 to 10% of the work is left before both ends meet. Two photos.

posts.author: Swarup Bodke
posts.text: Kurla (E) station: finishing work under way, roofing in its last stage. Three photos.

posts.author: Rajendra B. Aklekar
posts.text: The girders for Line 2B's crucial curve at the Nehru Nagar signal in Kurla (E) have been assembled. Four photos.

posts.author: Rajendra B. Aklekar
posts.text: Work on the crucial curve on SG Barve Marg at the Nehru Nagar signal, Kurla (E), has gathered pace after a building was demolished. Three photos.

posts.author: Hrishi
posts.text: Platform screen doors have started arriving on phase 2, D N Nagar to Saraswat Nagar. Track work is complete past Juhu Circle; overhead wire and signalling work is going on; the roof structure is in place. Juhu Circle should be done in three to four months. Two photos.

posts.author: Swarup Bodke
posts.text: A 64 m girder launched on CST Road, in front of the Kurla depot and Kanakia Zillion. Three photos.

posts.author: Haldilal
posts.text: MTNL Metro station in BKC. Video.

posts.author: Swarup Bodke
posts.text: A photo of Line 2B works, in a thread of metro photos.

posts.author: Maha Mumbai Metro
posts.text: Chembur station, newly opened, as a multimodal hub for the neighbourhood. Video.

posts.author: Swarup Bodke
posts.text: The pylon of the cable-stayed bridge over the Western Railway is taking shape on the Kalanagar side; temporary supports are in place to set the girders. Two photos.

posts.author: MMRDA
posts.text: Three composite steel girders across the Central Railway between Kurla and Vidyavihar, launched within two weeks over running suburban lines, in short railway blocks. Video.

posts.author: Arindam Mahapatra
posts.text: A girder launch for Line 2B near Tilak Nagar station. Quoting his earlier post: work is slow between Kurla (E) and Kurla Metro, where some piers were only recently started, and girders are being cast on site. One photo.
